text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Co-operative Societies (Exemption) Order 2010 and shall be deemed to have come into operation on 1st July 2010.
2. Every co-operative society named in the second column of the First Schedule is exempted from the provision of the Act specified opposite thereto in the first column.

heading.en: Application of certain provisions of Act with modifications or conditions

text.en: 3. The provision of the Act specified in the first column of the Second Schedule shall apply to each co-operative society and subject to the modification or condition set out opposite thereto in the second and third columns, respectively.
4. The Co-operative Societies (Exemption Orders) (Consolidation) Order (O 1) and the Co-operative Societies (Exemption) (Consolidation) Order (O 3) are revoked.

NTUC Thrift and Loan Co-operative Limited
Section 39(1)(a) of the Act shall apply with the modification that the reference in sub-paragraph (ii) to a citizen or resident in Singapore shall be a reference instead to a person —
(a)who is a member of the Singapore Maritime Officers Union or the Singapore Organisation of Seamen;
(b)who is not a member of the committee of management of the NTUC Thrift and Loan Co-operative Limited; and
(c)who is ineligible to and does not vote at any general meeting of the members of the NTUC Thrift and Loan Co-operative Limited.
2.Section 53(1) of the Act
Singapore National Co-operative Federation Limited
Section 53(1) of the Act shall apply with the modification that the co-operative society shall only be required to provide in its by-laws for a general meeting to be convened by the committee of management triennially.
3.Section 60(1) of the Act
Ngee Ann Polytechnic Consumer Co-operative Society Limited
Section 60(1)(a) of the Act shall apply with the modification that a person may be eligible for membership of or to remain as a member of the committee of management of the co-operative society if he is not below 18 years of age.
